notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Demo Update
This update addresses several smaller issues reported since the demo launch.



Fixes:

Minor visual and interaction bugs resolved

Small gameplay inconsistencies corrected

General stability improvements



Development is also ongoing on a major rework of the movement system, which will be the focus of the next significant update.

Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared feedback - your reviews are very helpful as the game continues to improve.
